entries.statement: New-source checklist (no one-offs, ever): any new data source enters through the same repeatable mechanism or not at all — (1) staging table ingest_<source>_* with raw jsonb + hash + fetch metadata, service-role only, greedy incl. raw HTML; (2) identity registration FIRST in series_external_ids before any derived write, collisions throw; (3) rules layer — what the source is authoritative for vs cross-check-only, recorded as a §10 row; conflicts and anomalies flag, never guess; (4) inline upkeep — registration and derived writes happen inside the source's regular puller, never a separate script someone must remember; (5) docs — source added to the §1 roster with role and reliability verdict.

entries.statement: Cron mechanics: pg_cron → invoke_edge_refresh(fn) (SECURITY DEFINER, reads Vault: edge_base_url / edge_anon_key / edge_cron_secret) → pg_net POST with the shared-secret header; functions verify x-cron-secret.
